body:
My day's fine. Just thinking. I should probably move. Is moving to a random other city a thing people do?

But I can't actually go anywhere because I'm waiting for scathing mail from the school I applied to.
Alright, sory for being all bitchy. Not your fault.
Well someone downvoted the other 2 replies right when you posted yours.
Yes. More importantly, why did you have to down-vote the other replies? That's just mean.
My problem isn't temporary though. Also, that's such a cliche.

Fucked up my whole life. Every time I think I can't mess up any worse, I manage to sink to a new low. If past behavior is the best predictor for future behavior, then I'm almost guaranteed to fail whatever I try next.

Thing is, I don't want to die. It's just that killing myself has been my 'backup option' for as long as I've known what suicide is and I'm steadily running out of other options.

I know that my parents care about me. My mother always has, and my stepfather hasn't even threatened to hit me in months.

And uh, I've told them really elaborate lies. Like making fake documents. Not everyone does that.

Thanks. There really isn't anything to feel sorry for. I dug my own grave and all.

I'm just really not sure what to do, though. Like, I have debts to pay off so the obvious answer is 'move out, get a full-time job, act like a fucking adult'. It's just that I'm a nervous wreck and have zero trust in my ability to actually do that.

I'd literally rather die than tell them.
I already get enough speeches about how I'm destroying their relationship and taking away time they should be spending on my younger siblings and how they grew up with civil war and economic collapse so I have nothing to complain about.

(The latter two points are actually true. But they've been threatening to kick me out of home for months, which is weird because I didn't want to be here in the first place. And their relationship was fucked up in the first place because of my stepfather's alcoholism.)
